spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶2:** The first proceeding of Divine truth into communic able form came forth from the Divine understanding itself. The love of truth that anim ates all illumination came forth from the active disc ernment of the Divine . The sphere of good from which all living affections are born came forth from the Divine interior perception . The union of love and wisdom that saves and con jo ins came forth from the Divine will's determination toward its ends . And the innoc ence of wisdom — truth held in its pure and unc orrupted state — came forth from the Divine refl ective discrimination of qualities .

**¶3:** In this manner were brought forth five orig inating goods, each the governing love of its own degree of spiritual life. These five successive states of Divine influx proceeded from the five operative powers of the Divine itself . Each descended from the one before it in discrete degree , and each was made manifest according to the state of reception prepared for it — for what proceeds from the Divine enters created forms not all at once, but in the order of read iness, each degree opening to receive only when the prior degree has been established as a ground .

---

* A note on method :* " Lim bs of the Father" — bod ily members in correspondence sign ify the powers through which the Divine acts out wardly. Five, as a number of full ness, here sign ifies the complete array of fac ulties by which the Divine proceeds into distinct operative forms . The sequential un folding — mind , thought, insight, counsel, consideration — traces a descent from the most interior ( understanding in itself ) to the most exterior (refl ective examination ), which corresponds precisely to the order of discrete degrees by which Divine life flows from in most willing to ou termost discernment.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The [Ambas]sador [came] from his mind; the Beloved of the Lights [from his thought]; the Mother of Life from his insight; [Jesus] the Beloved from his counsel; the Virgin of Lig[ht f]rom his consideration.
So in this way were summone[d these five] fathers. These five advents came from the five limbs [of the Father]. One came from another and was manifested in its season.
